hero.description: Hello, I'm Anthony. I bring technology, thoughtful design and practical problem-solving together to create useful digital experiences.

about.lead: I’m a technology professional who enjoys turning real-world challenges into useful digital solutions.
paragraphs: My work sits at the intersection of software development, IT operations, education technology and digital product delivery. I enjoy building applications, improving workflows, supporting people with technology and helping ideas move from concept to something useful.
From educational platforms and digital administration to backend systems and product concepts, I believe good technology should be reliable, accessible and built around the people who use it.

values.title: Purposeful building
values.text: I care about solving the right problem, not just writing code.

values.title: Practical experience
values.text: I connect technology with real operational and user needs.

values.title: Always learning
values.text: I keep growing through hands-on projects, teaching and collaboration.

skills.note: A growing mix of engineering, operations and product skills — applied with care and a focus on getting things done.
